note: Deterministic workflows ONLY. No Cube-side LLM steps in the demo path — Ember is the only brain. Each entry names the existing production flow or API it wraps. Approval tokens are injected by the orchestrator's approval step and are never shown to Ember.

tools.description: List the approved deterministic workflows the orchestrator may call.
tools.name: list_workflows
tools.returns: Catalog of workflow ids, names, and required inputs.

tools.description: Read live Metatron Watcher status (components up/down, open incidents, recent incidents, host summary) from the AIOps console API /api/overview. Read-only, deterministic.
tools.name: get_watcher_status
tools.returns: Component totals, open-incident count, recent incidents (trimmed), host summary, as one sanitised payload.

tools.description: Fire a deterministic webhook-triggered Activepieces flow. Requires a human approval token (injected by the approval step) — Ember proposes, a human approves, only then does this unlock.
tools.name: run_workflow

workflow_id.description: One of the catalog workflow ids that has a production flow.

tools.returns: Run id and status; results are read back via get_run_status.

tools.description: Poll the result of a fired workflow run.
tools.name: get_run_status
tools.returns: Run status and its deterministic result payload.

tools.description: File human-approved triaged help-desk tickets to the orchestrator board (a deterministic local store; no AI). Each ticket carries Ember's classification (category, priority), a draft reply, and a route. Requires a human approval token (injected by the approval step). Nothing is sent to requesters — drafts stay drafts until a human sends them.
tools.name: file_tickets

draft_reply.description: Short draft reply to the requester. A draft only — a human approves before anything is sent.

id.description: Ticket id from the input, e.g. TKT-001.

route.description: Team or queue the ticket routes to.

tools.returns: Count filed, board total, and the filed ticket ids.

workflows.dependency: WhatsApp template watcher_status_update (UTILITY, approved Nov 24, 2026; delivery confirmed). Flow verified Nov 26, 2026 via the Activepieces API: webhook trigger -> HTTP (AIOps overview) -> CODE (deterministic compose) -> WhatsApp send -> webhook return. No LLM steps.
workflows.name: Watcher Status to WhatsApp

workflows.dependency: Fixtures in fixtures/tickets.json. Filing route chosen Nov 26, 2026: the orchestrator's own board store. The Cube ITSM create path was rejected for the demo because it unconditionally runs a non-Ember model (auto-triage + sentiment) and sends notifications — both break the Ember-only rule.
workflows.name: Help-desk Triage Desk routing

workflows.dependency: Sample shape in fixtures/handover-sample.json; live runs pull the real endpoint.
workflows.name: Shift Handover Brief
